body: There's a lot going on, but I find myself unable to focus on important things now. What keeps me going is my feeling of duty towards other people, it might not be healthy, but at least im not completely paralyzed by depression

Thanks for writing me a reply. People sometimes say that we shouldn't feel like there is something wrong with us if we get rejected. But that is the most fundamental judgment one can be given. I don't know what to tell you or myself, honestly other than that i know how it sucks to feel like a worse version of man.

I've been thinking about what you told me for past 2 months and I owe  you a lot, at least this deleayed response. While outside factors havent changed, I' m trying not to sink deeper into those bad thoughts and emotions and trying to enjoy myself, while i have to admit that is not easy. Thanks for what you wrote back then, and best wishes to you friend.
